last_completed_normal_slice: First controlled read-only validation command execution
last_completed_repair: ZIP hygiene repair for packaged debug artifacts
active_slice: Read-only command result diagnosis and blocked/failed classification
next_normal_slice: Read-only command result diagnosis and blocked/failed classification
out_of_scope: broad shell execution beyond the single allowlisted JSON validation command
automatic retry or correction after diagnosis
architecture_invariants: control surface is authoritative over conversation memory
repair releases must not advance scope
actuation moves only through gated safety layers
loop execution cannot mutate Project Sources or adopt artifacts unless a slice explicitly permits it
repository paths in policies and configs remain repo-relative

rolling_slice_horizon.slice: Read-only command result diagnosis and blocked/failed classification
rolling_slice_horizon.scope: classify read-only command outcomes as passed, blocked, or failed without correction or file mutation
produce a bounded correction plan from diagnosis evidence without writing files

rolling_slice_horizon.slice: First controlled file mutation in sandboxed fixture only
rolling_slice_horizon.scope: perform the first mutation only inside an explicit sandbox fixture with before/after evidence

rolling_slice_horizon.slice: Sandbox mutation verification and rollback evidence gate
rolling_slice_horizon.scope: verify sandbox mutation result evidence and define rollback/stop gates before broader correction workflows
decide whether sandbox-only correction evidence is ready for broader controlled correction workflows without deployment

replan_rules: Normal releases may update the rolling horizon when the decision is recorded in docs/project/decisions.md.
Repair releases must keep scope_advance_allowed=false and may not change the active normal slice.
A failed or ambiguous control-surface validation blocks packaging and adoption.
Changing architecture invariants requires an explicit architecture decision record.
